name: Ash Cloud
body:
School conjuration [air, fire]; Level adept 2, magus 2, shaman 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, unchained summoner 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of ash)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 20-foot-radius burst
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Fortitude, see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You summon a roiling cloud of ash and smoke in the area. The cloud is difficult terrain for flying creatures due to the shifting temperatures but it does not cause concealment. However, it is impossible to use scent within the area.

When a creature ends their turn within the area of the smoke, they must make a Fortitude save or be nauseated for 1 round from smoke inhalation and take 1d4 fire damage from the burning ash in the lungs. On a success, the creature is only sickened for 1 round. If a creature does not need to breathe or if they are immune to fire damage, they are immune to these effects.
